featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: A historic Roman Catholic Church located in Jacob Circle. Built in 1913, this church is dedicated to St. Ignatius Loyola. It is one of the oldest churches in Mumbai. Its interior is beautiful having wooden pews, stained glass window panes, supporting pillars etc. There is a wall carving of the Last Supper above the Altar. The facade of this church had a statue of Jesus Christ above it. There is a belfry tower at the side of the church. Also, there is a Latin inscription at the entrance. It has a school attached to it. Had attended a funeral mass service in this church in English language. It is an ideal place for local devotees as well as people of other faith.

featured_reviews.name: Terence Correia
featured_reviews.review_text:
St. Ignatius Church is where my faith, friendships, and fondest memories were all nurtured. It was here that I was baptized, received my First Communion, and was confirmed, milestones that marked the beginning of my spiritual journey. As a child and youth, I was an active part of the Legion of Mary and St. Anthony’s group, served as an altar server, and joined the youth and prayer groups. I loved helping with church cleaning, decorating the crib, making the Christmas star, and organizing events, all while laughing and playing around the church compound with friends who became like family.

Those days were filled with joy, service, and deep connections, memories I treasure even now. Seeing the church restored to its former glory, after more than 100 years since its foundation, fills my heart with happiness. St. Ignatius Church remains a timeless place of faith, community, and love, where every stone tells the story of generations who have grown, served, and celebrated here.

PowaiConnect is my family away from family!
I was new to Bombay and God led me to this wonderful group of people.
The first thing I felt about this place was how genuine everyone is. There is no pretense. We come as we are in the presence of God wanting to be transformed a little more like Christ every day.
Every week we are taught from God's word and it equips us to live out His word in our lives.
The fellowship is so great here, everyone is always ready to help in times of trouble and celebrate with you in the good times. And along the way we together learn how to overcome various sins and live according to His word by the power of the Holy Spirit.
There are elders and mentors who are willing to invest in our lives and disciple us in our faith journey. It speaks of God's heart for the individual person.

So come join our family every Sunday at 10 am and you will feel right at home. :)

There are many Churches in Powai but there are few things I believe PowaiConnect stands out and these could be a reason for you to drop by:
1) People are loving, caring, kind and willing to take the extra mile to help each others.
2) Every sunday sermon brings out the Gospel in a new way.
3) Most of the people are living in Powai, and willing to meet and pray if needed.
4) The midweek connect groups makes it more relational to connect, to share, to pray and grow in small groups.
5) The groups go out to have fun evenings, like movies, picnics, camps, foodie nights.
6) Very active on social media, so you know what to expect each sunday.
7) There are more in store like Celebrating birthdays, and other special occassions.  Spontaneous jamming evenings.  Healthy discussions. Cooking Nights. Familys meals.
7) Currently they meet right at the centre of Powai, just behind Star Bucks.

🙂

featured_reviews.review_text: The Gloria church is an iconic church of Byculla. It is designed in the gothic style of architecture. featured_reviews.name: Vivek Vetal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visiting Gloria Church in Byculla, Mumbai felt like discovering a gentle pause button hidden within the city. In a part of Mumbai that is constantly buzzing with movement, people, and stories, the church stands as a serene reminder that beauty doesn’t always shout—sometimes it simply waits for you to notice it.

From the moment I approached the church, I was struck by its quiet dignity. The structure rises gracefully, not trying to overpower its surroundings but still unmistakably commanding attention. Stepping inside, there was an immediate shift in energy. The air felt calmer, almost sacred, as if the space itself encouraged you to slow your pace and lower your voice—not out of obligation, but out of respect.

What stayed with me most was the sense of warmth the church offers. The soft light filtering through the windows, the gentle echo of footsteps, and the stillness of the interiors create an atmosphere that feels deeply personal. Even if you walk in as a visitor with no specific purpose, the space makes you feel welcome. I found myself sitting quietly, absorbing the calm, letting my thoughts settle—something that rarely happens in the rush of everyday life.

There’s a powerful emotional depth in Gloria Church that goes beyond its architecture. You can sense the **generations of faith, hope, and prayer** that have passed through these walls. The church feels lived-in, not in a worn-out way, but in a way that reflects continuity and care. It stands as a witness to countless personal moments—gratitude, grief, joy, and silent reflection.

What I appreciated most is how Gloria Church doesn’t demand anything from you. It simply offers space—space to reflect, to feel grounded, and to reconnect with something deeper, whether that’s faith, history, or inner peace. It’s not just a religious landmark; it’s an emotional anchor in the city.

For anyone exploring Mumbai beyond its usual landmarks, Gloria Church is worth visiting—not just to see it, but to experience it. You leave feeling calmer, more centred, and quietly grateful for spaces that still allow the soul to breathe.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar d
featured_reviews.review_text:
Gloria Church, located in Byculla, Mumbai, stands on one of the oldest Roman Catholic church sites in the city.
2.  The original church, known as Nossa Senhora da Glória, was built in 1632 by Portuguese Franciscans (with some sources crediting the deSouza e Lima family).
3.  It was initially located in Mazagaon and served the community for over three centuries.
4.  The present structure was constructed between 1911–1913 (completed in 1913) in beautiful English Gothic Revival style.
5.  The church features stunning Gothic tracery in stone-carved windows, tall spires, and intricate architectural details inspired by European cathedrals.
6.  It celebrated its centenary (100 years of the current building) in 2013.
7.  The site has a continuous history of worship spanning over 400 years, making it a significant heritage landmark.
8.  The church is famous for its vibrant stained glass windows that create colorful light effects inside during the day.
9.  It underwent major restoration and reopened in 2018, appearing even more magnificent with its 160-feet tall structure.
10.  Gloria Church remains an active parish under the Archdiocese of Bombay and is a popular spot for locals and visitors seeking peace and history.
This beautiful church continues to be a symbol of faith and Mumbai’s Portuguese colonial heritage!

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Prakash
featured_reviews.review_text: It’s a place where everyone is warmly welcomed and where the focus is on a right relationship, not just religion. The community is strong, and the leaders are very friendly and approachable. Beyond Sundays, there’s so much to grow through - Weekly Connect Groups, the Foundation Course, camps, and counseling - open to everyone, irrespective of past faith or ethnicity. Blessed community of people who are empathetic and spreading love to the neighborhood in Powai.

featured_reviews.name: Alka Puri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being part of this church and its connect group gives me some of the most unforgettable memories—the fun we have, the amazing food we share, and the chaotic game nights that never go as planned. And, of course, all the times I’ve cried here (you all see the real me!).

Even though I see everyone on Sundays, par connect groups ki baat hi kuch aur hai. 🤗🙌

I’m so grateful to the church for creating such a warm, welcoming space where friendships flourish, faith deepens, and joy truly abounds. If you’re looking for a place where you can feel loved, supported, and at home, this is the perfect place to be.

featured_reviews.name: Sheeba John
featured_reviews.review_text: YNC as I experience is a God loving - people loving church. Very organized with realistic approach towards its community and people around. Values deep rooted in Gospel truth and Christ centric. It's members are very welcoming making it a friendly community. Fellowship is backbone. We wouldn't just meet on Sunday worship but also mid week for connect groups (CG), prayer/worship nights and occasionally for outing/camping making the community and bonds more real and deep. The church space also has a closed feeding room/child care room within the hall (besides separate Sunday school room for kids) making it even more possible and comfortable for moms with new born and toddlers to be able to worship live. Such a joy to witness the act of "being filled and to fill' happening here. Thanking God for this church and the people in it.

featured_reviews.name: Joshua Joseph
featured_reviews.review_text:
Great place to worship. This place feels like home. The space is lovely and it's on the 18th floor, so you can imagine the breathtaking view of the city from up there. Great and fun set of people from different backgrounds, places, age groups, etc so  there's something for everyone here. It's a place filled with people who love the Lord and those who are getting to know God's love.
Best part is that everyone is welcome here no matter what - whether you are a Christian or not. Apart from worship songs & sermon there are other regular fun activities planned for everyone like camps, retreats, seminars, football game and regular hangouts over a meal or indoor games.

If you're in Mumbai, come check this place out on Sundays from 10am onwards.

featured_reviews.name: K Koshy
featured_reviews.review_text: I came across YNC while planning my move to Mumbai. A simple Google search led me to a community that would soon feel like my spiritual family. From the moment you walk into the meeting space (or log into the Zoom service), you feel the warmth and welcome. The worship is Spirit-led and the preaching is solidly grounded in Scripture, so I would not hesitate recommending this church to anyone looking for a Christ-centered community in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Lydia Priyadarshini
featured_reviews.review_text:
Being new to this city, i was constantly looking out for a church and place where I could connect to and worship God and through a family member we got to know about this place. The fellowship i get here reminds me that I am not alone and helps me in my daily walk with Christ and has also enabled me to realise that having a personal relationship with God is more important than just our external good works.
Also, if you are looking for a wonderful Sunday school experience for your little ones then this is the place where they are not just taught but also given activities so that deep biblical truth is imbibed in them at an young age itself.

featured_reviews.name: Sophia Luther
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you're looking for a good church, this is IT.
I think for me CG has been an integral part of our journey in Mumbai. We have not just survived Mumbai but thrived here as a family because of YNC and Thrusday CG

I personally saw a big difference in my marriage and my house and my family ever since the first CG/ pot luck happened at our place.
